name: Dubai Style Chocolate Latte
caffeineNote: No figure published; the ingredient list carries both instant coffee and matcha green tea powder
summary: Dubai-chocolate-style latte built on instant coffee and matcha powder rather than brewed coffee, with whole milk powder, non-dairy creamer, cocoa and pistachios, and colored with FD&C Yellow No. 5 and Blue No. 1. VISVITA publishes no nutrition panel for it, so every figure here stays blank until we check a can.
